points.text: Construction recipe, grader and calibration metric are adapted from BrowseComp; novelty is an adaptation.
Chinese-web specificity and translation claim asserted without experiment or source-platform analysis.
Abstract promises censorship-related complexities but no section examines censorship.
Positioning against prior benchmarks thin; no comparison table; 'first' claim unsupported.
Topic coverage skewed by annotator interests; results not broken down by topic.
No-browsing models exceed 20%, showing parametric answerability; benchmark does not isolate browsing.
Evaluating closed commercial products measures systems, not LLMs; no controlled open agent baseline.
Answer uniqueness checked only with failing agents; residual ambiguity and gold error rate unknown.
No independent human solvers, inter-annotator agreement or human performance number.
Difficulty defined as unsolved by a peer in ten minutes says little about solvability.
Reasoning gains attributed by comparing different model generations; thinking settings unstated.
Search effect inferred from R1 API vs DeepSeek product, which are different systems.
Claim that search increases calibration error contradicted by Table 1.
Conclusion that multi-turn products outperform parametric models contradicted by Table 1.
Single run, no variance or confidence intervals; many differences within noise.
Claims statistically significant multi-round advantage without any test.
Product evaluation not reproducible: annotators, dates, versions, modes unreported; model strings incomplete.
GPT-4o grader not validated against human judgments.
Grader defaults missing confidence to 100, possibly inflating calibration error; frequency unreported.
Circularity: questions filtered against systems that are later evaluated and ranked.
No contamination analysis; open release without canary or encryption.
'Nearly 8%' improvement is actually 7.3 points.
Appendix references mislabeled; introduction finding duplicates Section 4.6.
Adversarially filtered trivia questions do not reflect real information needs; ecological validity lacking.
Search backend, region and temporal snapshot uncontrolled; retrieval access confounds model ability.
No process-level analysis of search trajectories; single-round claim made without logs.
No cost or latency analysis.
No ethics or data statement: personal data, source licences, annotator compensation.
Public release enables memorization; no contamination statement or canary.
Gold-answer validity and uniqueness unmeasured; no human solvability or error rate.
Non-browsing accuracy shows parametric answerability; benchmark does not isolate browsing.
Calibration-rises-with-search claim contradicted by Table 1.
Multi-turn products outperform parametric models claim unsupported; only DeepResearch does.
'Statistical analysis' claimed with no test.
Reasoning effects confounded by comparing different models.
Search effects confounded by product vs API comparison with different grading.
Filtering used systems later ranked; induced bias not analyzed.
No contamination control; open release without canary.
Censorship-related complexities claim never tested.
Claim that translated English benchmarks are not meaningful is never tested.
No confidence intervals; differences of few questions read as ranks.
Default confidence of 100 in grader prompt may inflate calibration error.
Empty parentheses for model versions; product dates missing.
'Nearly 8%' stated for 7.3 points.
Analysis thin: no per-topic accuracy breakdown.
No analysis by question length or number of constraints.
No failure-case study or error taxonomy.
No human accuracy reference.
Multi-turn products outperform parametric models claim contradicted by Table 1.
Search increases calibration error claim contradicted by DeepResearch result.
'Significantly higher accuracy' claimed without a test.
Censorship-related complexities mentioned in abstract but never examined.
Only 289 questions limits statistical resolution.
Single run, no confidence intervals; rankings in 5-30% range unreliable.
Related work is a list; claim that prior Chinese sets lack control undemonstrated; no comparison table.
Model names in Section 4.1 have empty version parentheses.
Appendix references mislabeled.
Wording typo and findings duplicated between introduction and Section 4.
Only 289 questions; small scale weakens robustness.
Unique-answer guarantee depends on current model limits and annotator creativity.
Incremental contribution; task construction closely mirrors BrowseComp.
289 queries insufficient for representativeness and statistical robustness.
No analysis whether gaps stem from language change or Chinese web ecosystem; no cross-lingual ablation.
Creation process mirrors BrowseComp; contribution incremental.
Cultural groundedness not verified; reliance on exclusively Chinese sources unchecked.
No failure-mode analysis of retrieval vs cultural misinterpretation errors.
Small dataset of 289 questions.
Reverse design cannot fully guarantee answer uniqueness.
Dataset contains obvious bugs needing fixes.
Insufficiently challenging compared to BrowseComp.
Simplified Chinese adaptation lacking originality.

P.summary: Novelty is an adaptation of BrowseComp methodology.
Chinese-web specificity and translation-inadequacy claims untested.
Censorship-related complexity claimed but never examined.
Weak positioning vs prior benchmarks; no comparison table.
No per-topic accuracy breakdown; topic coverage skewed.
Parametric answerability; benchmark does not isolate browsing.
Closed products evaluated; no controlled open agent baseline.
Gold-answer uniqueness and validity not measured.
No human performance reference.
Difficulty criterion weak.
Reasoning-effect claims confounded by different models.
Search-effect claims confounded by product vs API comparison.
Search-increases-calibration-error claim contradicted by Table 1.
Multi-turn products outperform parametric models claim contradicted.
Single run, no variance or confidence intervals.
Significance claimed without statistical test.
Model/product versions and dates unreported; not reproducible.
GPT-4o grader not validated against humans.
Default confidence 100 may inflate calibration error.
Circularity: filtering against later-evaluated systems.
No contamination control or canary for release.
'Nearly 8%' misstates 7.3 points.
Presentation minors: appendix labels, duplicated findings, typo.
Ecological validity: questions not real information needs.
Search backend, region, time uncontrolled.
No process-level search trajectory analysis.
No cost or latency analysis.
Missing ethics, privacy and data statement.
No analysis by question length or constraint count.
No failure-case or error analysis.
Small benchmark size limits statistical resolution.

Q.summary: Chinese-specific difficulty/cultural grounding not empirically verified.
